title: Records for Tony, Joe Moretz and the Rosemary Clooney release problem
summary: He made many records with Tony and for Joe Moretz, one unreleased because Rosemary Clooney sang on it.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.s: Mrs. Joe Loyacano (wife of Joe Loyacano)
blocks.x: he made the record when my my other brother had died she was born that time she's 33 years old that's how long that first record he's made lots with tony records and he's made lots he made some records for joe morez with moncaso and them i don't know did they ever release those records no

couldn't release them because Rosemary Clooney sang and Rosemary Clooney was an exclusive Columbia recording artist and they wouldn't let the records loose. Joe Moretz made the records and they wouldn't turn the records loose. He played with Almond Hug, you made the records with Hug. I made the records with Hug, yeah.
Almond said how wonderful it was he could just walk in the studio and hear those tunes and come up.
